Hello,

I saw Binated is hiring a UI/UX Designer in Pune and caught that the team works closely on development handoff, which aligns well with my background.

I hold a B.Tech in Computer Science and spent seven months at AT Creation building wireframes and user flows in Figma alongside developers. I also carried this technical mindset into my B2B case study, Bounceless, which demonstrates an end-to-end user flow for verification experiences. You can review my work at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

I am currently based in Nagpur and ready to relocate to Pune for this role.

Could we take a 15-minute look at my Bounceless case study next week?

Ananya

Ananya Saini
+91-8605846929
